title: A technical user who wants the knobs
why: Someone who speaks in layer paths and metrics should be answered in those terms, with the report and the numbers, and with facts looked up rather than remembered.

artist.who: Wen, a machine-learning engineer who knows diffusion models well.
artist.wants: A clean comparison of two specific bends, with numbers.
rules: After the comparison ask: which executed steps did that t-window cover with 6 LCM steps?
artist.ends_when: the assistant has answered which steps the window covered.

first_message: On SD1.5 LCM, compare rotate 90° on middle_block.1 at t 1.0→0.7 against scale 0.7 on input_blocks.4, same seed, prompt 'a lighthouse on a sea cliff at dusk, oil painting'. I want the MAE per candidate and the resolved layers.
expected: Answers in his terms (layer paths, ops, t-windows, MAE) and drops the everyday metaphors, because he speaks technically
Renders an unbent baseline and the two candidates on one seed, each bend with a label
Gives the MAE and the flags per candidate (compare_images) and the resolved layers from the bend report
Passes on anything else the report shows (expanded containers, skipped paths, clamped amounts)
Answers the step question from timestep_windows (not from memory)
Delivers without first asking about depth or autonomy
watch_for: Are the numbers it quotes the ones the tools returned?
